fields.hint: Short summary of who this community is for.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero image
fields.hint: Full-bleed header background. Blank falls back to the centered header.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline
fields.hint: Subtitle beneath the "HARVARD IN TECH <NAME>" title.

fields.name: showGallery
fields.label: Show event gallery
fields.hint: Blank shows the gallery; switch off to hide it on this community.

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.label: Contact email
fields.hint: Blank falls back to the global contact email in Settings.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Optional pin. Blank sorts the community alphabetically by name.

fields.name: tier
fields.label: Partnership level
fields.hint: The level id from the Sponsorship page settings (presenting, chapter, event, community). Blank groups the sponsor under Other partners.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.hint: Blank shows the sponsor's name as text instead.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Example entry
fields.hint: Switch ON for an illustrative entry. The wall then shows an 'examples, not actual sponsors' notice. Leave OFF for a real sponsor.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Optional pin. Blank sorts the sponsor alphabetically within its level.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.hint: How the donor should be credited. Still required for an anonymous gift — the site hides it, our records keep it.

fields.name: tier
fields.label: Giving level
fields.hint: The level id from the Momentum Fund page settings (leadership, sustaining, supporting). Blank or unrecognized groups the donor under Other supporters rather than hiding them.

fields.name: founding
fields.label: Founding donor
fields.hint: Switch ON to show the Founding Donor badge. It is a badge, not a level — a founding donor keeps whatever giving level they gave at.

fields.name: anonymous
fields.label: List anonymously
fields.hint: Switch ON when the donor asked not to be named. The wall shows 'Anonymous donor' and drops their website link; this entry still keeps the name for our records.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.hint: One short line shown on the donor's card. Their words, or ours about them.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Website
fields.hint: LinkedIn or a personal site. Ignored when the gift is listed anonymously.

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: Blank shows the donor's initials instead.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Optional pin. Blank sorts the donor alphabetically within their giving level.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Section type
fields.hint: Which section this is: narrative, accomplishments, pillars, testimonials, or stats. Only "narrative" uses the title, layout, image, and body below — the others are bands whose content is edited elsewhere.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Heading
fields.hint: Narrative sections only. The heading shown above the text.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Layout
fields.hint: Narrative sections only: image-left, image-right, or text-only. Blank or unrecognized shows the text full width.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.hint: Shown beside the text on image-left / image-right sections. Blank shows the text full width.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear higher on the page. Change this to move a section up or down. Blank puts the section last.

fields.name: comingSoon
fields.label: Show as coming soon
fields.hint: Switch ON to replace this section with a short "coming soon" placeholder. Switch the Draft toggle on instead to remove the section and its menu link entirely. Both off means the section shows normally.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Section type
fields.hint: Which band this is: hero, stats, events, chapters, focus, content-hub, board, get-involved, giving, whatsapp, support, gallery, or contact. A value matching none of those drops that one band and is named in the build log.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Heading
fields.hint: Only used by the "coming soon" placeholder, as the heading it announces. Blank falls back to the section's usual name.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear higher on the page. Change this to move a section up or down. Blank puts it last.

fields.name: comingSoon
fields.label: Show as coming soon
fields.hint: Switch ON to replace this section with a short "coming soon" placeholder. Switch the Draft toggle on instead to remove the section and its menu link entirely. Both off means the section shows normally.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: The large headline on the slide.

fields.name: kicker
fields.label: Kicker
fields.hint: The small line above the headline.

fields.name: lede
fields.label: Lede
fields.hint: The paragraph beneath the headline.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.hint: The full-bleed photo behind the slide. Blank leaves the crimson backdrop.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers come first in the rotation. Blank puts the slide last.

fields.name: ctas
fields.label: Buttons
fields.hint: Up to two buttons. Variant "solid" is the filled button, "out" is the outlined one; anything else renders solid.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Figure
fields.hint: The big number, e.g. 8,000+ or Est. 2013.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.hint: The small caption under the figure.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear further left. Blank puts the figure last.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Figure
fields.hint: The big number on the card, e.g. 600+.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.hint: What the figure counts.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: One or two sentences beneath the figure.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear first. Blank puts the card last.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: What this gift powers.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.hint: One of people, book, or globe. Anything else falls back to people.

fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Link label
fields.hint: Optional link at the bottom of the card. Leave both link fields blank for a plain card.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.hint: Lower numbers appear first. Blank puts the card last.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page
fields.hint: Which page these settings belong to.

fields.name: donateUrl
fields.label: Donation platform URL
fields.hint: Where every Give button points. Blank keeps them on the giving-inquiry email, which is what they do today. Paste a real platform URL here to switch them all over at once.

events.name: chapter
events.label: Chapter or community
events.hint: The slug of the chapter or community this event belongs to (the filename without .md). Blank means it belongs to neither and shows only on the events page.

seo.name: metaTitle
seo.label: SEO title
seo.hint: The <title> and share-card title. Falls back to the entry title.

seo.name: metaDescription
seo.label: Meta description
seo.hint: The search + social description. Falls back to the summary, then the site default.

seo.name: ogImage
seo.label: Share image
seo.hint: The social share card image. Falls back to the site default.
